description: We are a team of ambitious university students passionate about space exploration, innovation, and solving real-world problems. We aim to combine creative thinking, scientific research, and technology to develop practical and impactful solutions using NASA’s open data. We believe that teamwork, curiosity, and determination can turn innovative ideas into meaningful projects.
summary:
**WENAK** is an AI-powered Mars exploration and navigation website designed to help future astronauts explore the Martian surface safely, efficiently, and independently.

Inspired by Apple Vision Pro, WENAK combines NASA Mars imagery from HiRISE, CTX, and Mars Trek with an interactive map, intelligent route planning, and a first-person exploration simulation. The system compares three routes based on travel time, safety, and scientific value, while demonstrating automatic rerouting when unexpected hazards occur.

WENAK also features an AI voice assistant, offline return-to-base navigation, emergency alerts, mission data recording, and a proposed contactless health-monitoring approach inspired by Welltra AI's camera-based rPPG technology. The prototype distinguishes authentic NASA observations from simulated mission conditions.

Because communication between Earth and Mars can experience significant delays, astronauts need greater autonomy during exploration. WENAK addresses this challenge by bringing navigation, scientific awareness, health information, and emergency support together in one intuitive spatial interface, demonstrating a pathway toward safer and more effective human exploration of Mars.

WENAK — Project Details

1. Project Overview

WENAK is an AI-powered Mars exploration and navigation website designed to support future astronauts during surface exploration missions. Inspired by Apple Vision Pro, WENAK combines NASA planetary imagery, intelligent navigation, scientific exploration, astronaut safety monitoring, and emergency assistance into one interactive spatial interface.

Our goal is to transform complex Martian scientific information into clear, accessible guidance that helps astronauts explore more efficiently and independently.

2. How WENAK Works

WENAK consists of three interconnected modules:

Mission Dashboard: Displays mission information, astronaut location, environmental conditions, equipment status, health indicators, communication status, and emergency notifications.

Smart Route Planner: Uses an A* pathfinding algorithm to compare three navigation options: the fastest route, the safest
